主要内容: Broadway Financial Corporation entered into a Settlement and Release Agreement with Robert C. Davidson, a director, on March 24, 2021, related to the prospective termination of the Director Emeritus Policy. Under the agreement, Broadway agreed to pay Mr. Davidson $120,000, and Mr. Davidson waived and released any claims related to the Director Emeritus Policy. The agreement was filed as Exhibit 10.1 in the Form 8-K filing dated March 29, 2021. The settlement reflects a compensatory arrangement for the director's departure, with no further details provided on the terms or reasons for the policy termination. The transaction is specific to the company and does not mention broader industry or market impacts.
